# =============================================================================
# Top40EcoBoostMod - per-nation eco setup (GENERATED by gen_ecoboost_configs.py).
# DO NOT HAND-EDIT - edit SELECT_ECOBOOST_FINAL.csv and re-run the generator.
# champ N = 2*tier ; each support N = 1*tier ; each flavour = +1 (additive seed).
# Generic helpers (eco_seed_capped / eco_seed_flavour / eco_cleanup_flags / etc.)
# live in eco_effects.txt.
# =============================================================================

# ---- China (CHI): champ tea(20); support x6 (10 each); flavour x9 ----
eco_setup_CHI = {
	eco_seed_capped = { B = building_tea_plantation TYPE = champ   N = 20 }

	eco_seed_capped = { B = building_fishing_wharf TYPE = support N = 10 }
	eco_seed_capped = { B = building_logging_camp TYPE = support N = 10 }
	eco_seed_capped = { B = building_furniture_manufactory TYPE = support N = 10 }
	eco_seed_capped = { B = building_textile_mill TYPE = support N = 10 }
	eco_seed_capped = { B = building_food_industry TYPE = support N = 10 }
	eco_seed_capped = { B = building_silk_plantation TYPE = support N = 10 }

	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_coal_mine TYPE = flavour }
	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_lead_mine TYPE = flavour }
	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_sulfur_mine TYPE = flavour }
	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_dye_plantation TYPE = flavour }
	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_opium_plantation TYPE = flavour }
	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_tobacco_plantation TYPE = flavour }
	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_banana_plantation TYPE = flavour }
	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_cotton_plantation TYPE = flavour }
	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_vineyard TYPE = flavour }

	add_modifier = { name = eco_CHI_champ_tp_p1 months = 240 }
	every_scope_state = {
		limit = { is_incorporated = yes }
		add_modifier = { name = eco_sol_p1 months = 240 }
	}
	trigger_event = { id = eco.3 years = 20 }
	if = { limit = { is_player = yes } trigger_event = { id = eco.4 } }
	eco_cleanup_flags = yes
}
